Author: FranFkntastic
Name: MarketMafioso
Punchline: Free Company workshop production, market-board buying, and player handoff.
Description: Free Company workshop production, market-board buying, and player handoff. Plan workshop projects and their materials across bags and retainers, run assembly, and hand items to another player through the Trade Queue. An optional self-hosted Workshop Host unlocks Market Acquisition buying runs and inventory history. Use /mmf to open MarketMafioso.
Changelog: Removes the Squire launcher tab; Squire is no longer bundled with MarketMafioso.
